gap: No result ChatGPT got states that every pick's compressor fridge has a 3-stage low-voltage cut-off, and that Dometic's own CFX5 manual tells owners to set it to HIGH on a vehicle starter battery and LOW only on a separate supply battery. Without that setting, the plan of running the fridge off the car overnight is the one that strands the shopper.
standout_why: OutdoorGearLab (cited, read 2026-11-08) says Dometic has a 'three-stage battery protection system' and the BougeRV 'automatically shuts off when the voltage drops'. It also warns against long runs on a car battery and already gives the thermoelectric limit (35-40°F below ambient). It never says which protection level to use on a starter battery, and it gives no voltages. ChatGPT's own answer only says 'avoid leaving the cooler connected to your vehicle's starter battery overnight'. I could not read gearandhome.com, the other cited page, because of an SSL certificate error. So the rivals have part of this finding: the feature exists. What is new is the maker's instruction on which setting to use for each battery type.
decides: This leaves the compressor-over-thermoelectric pick unchanged. What it changes is the advice that goes with it: the shopper can run the BougeRV, ICECO VL45 or Dometic CFX5 straight off the car, as long as the battery protection is set to HIGH. A built-in-battery model (Anker SOLIX EverFrost 2) or a power station (Dealectric lists several) is what makes overnight off-grid use work without touching the starter battery. That backs ChatGPT's own 'How will you power it?' fork with the maker's reasoning.

findings.label: Battery monitor mode for starter battery vs supply battery
findings.value: Starter battery: HIGH; supply (house/aux) battery: LOW is enough
findings.source_title: Dometic CFX5 operating manual (ManualsLib copy), 9.3 Using the battery monitor
findings.note: Verbatim: 'When the cooling device is supplied by the starter battery, select the battery monitor mode "HIGH".' and 'If the cooling device is connected to a supply battery, the battery monitor mode "LOW" will suffice.' The manual also says the unit 'switches off automatically as soon as the supply voltage falls below a set level' and restarts at the 'restart voltage level'. It covers the CFX5 25/35/45/55IM/75DZ/95DZ.

findings.label: Battery protection purpose and recommended level (Dometic support)
findings.value: 3 levels (High/Medium/Low): High or Medium on a starter battery, Low on an accessory or dual battery
findings.source_title: Dometic Support: What are the recommended settings for the battery protection system
findings.note: A companion Dometic support page (https://support.dometic.com/en/cfx5-coolers/What-is-the-battery-protection-system-4263) says the system 'actively monitors inbound DC voltage and turns off the cooler if it senses low voltage... designed primarily to prevent the cooler from draining your vehicle's starter battery'.
